Winter cross-training: Zwift ramp test on 2025-02-09 on the Wahoo KICKR Core in the basement with my old Trek Domane AL2 (the one from Kijiji, $480 in 2021). Start 100 W, +20 W per minute until failure. Lasted 13:12, best 1 min power 224 W, so FTP = 168 W. At 61 kg that's 2.75 W/kg. Max HR 176, lower than running max (186) as expected. Retest 2025-04-06: FTP 176 W, 2.89 W/kg. Zones set from that for the easy spins in race week of [[Marathon taper]] and on rest days when the legs need blood flow without impact. On snow days it's this or [[Rowing machine intervals]].
